The save DC that the most potent afflictions force their victims to overcome.

The higher of your Maneuver Save DC or your Spell Save DC, + 2.

Check the combat log for the actual DC.

The creature takes [1] at the start of its turn for each remaining turn of this effect. Each hit reduces duration by 1 and releases a toxic burst within [4], infecting nearby creatures with Toxemia.

Once its duration exceeds [2] turns, at the start of its turn the creature must make a Constitution saving throw against the source's Potency DC. On a failure, Toxemia Paralyses it for [3] turn and dispels. On a success, its duration is set to [5].
